bootstrap_note.en: Initial review projection derived only from the verified frozen specification, freeze record, and explicitly confirmed public milestones. Later updates must be generated from canonical local ledgers and release records.
bootstrap_note.sl: Začetna pregledna projekcija je izpeljana samo iz preverjene zamrznjene specifikacije, zapisa o zamrznitvi in izrecno potrjenih javnih mejnikov. Poznejše posodobitve morajo nastati iz kanoničnih lokalnih ledgerjev in release zapisov.

phase_label.en: Phase 0 — Evidence boundary and truth separation
phase_label.sl: Faza 0 — dokazna meja in ločitev resnice

label.en: Architecture Spec v0.2.2 frozen and SHA3-256 verified
label.sl: Architecture Spec v0.2.2 zamrznjen in SHA3-256 preverjen

label.en: Appoint a Phase-0 Curator and a separate Independent Truth Reviewer, then create isolated Phase-0 workspace and storage roots.
label.sl: Imenuj Phase-0 Curatorja in ločenega Independent Truth Reviewerja, nato ustvari izolirane Phase-0 delovne in podatkovne korene.

next_permitted_step.permission_required: Explicit BD approval and confirmed access separation
blocked_actions: Builder access to any evaluator-only truth material

claim_boundary.en: Architecture is fixed; implementation effectiveness is not yet demonstrated.
claim_boundary.sl: Arhitektura je zamrznjena; učinkovitost implementacije še ni dokazana.

claim_boundary.en: No Builder-safe/evaluator-truth package split has yet passed the public gates.
claim_boundary.sl: Ločitev Builder-safe in evaluator-truth paketov še ni prestala javnih gateov.

claim_boundary.en: Not yet built or independently evaluated.
claim_boundary.sl: Še ni zgrajen ali neodvisno ovrednoten.

claim_boundary.en: Opens only after an accepted Observer release.
claim_boundary.sl: Odpre se šele po sprejetem Observer releasu.

claim_boundary.en: No autonomous exploitation/evolution proof is claimed.
claim_boundary.sl: Dokaz avtonomnega exploitation/evolution še ni zahtevan ali dosežen.

claim_boundary.en: No blind proof that the system independently reopens an exhausted representation.
claim_boundary.sl: Ni slepega dokaza, da sistem sam ponovno odpre izčrpano reprezentacijo.

claim_boundary.en: No matched proof that Human–AI H-REOPEN adds measurable value over no-H-REOPEN.
claim_boundary.sl: Ni matched dokaza, da Human–AI H-REOPEN merljivo preseže no-H-REOPEN.

claim_boundary.en: No independent-judge held-out META advantage is claimed.
claim_boundary.sl: Ni trditve o held-out META prednosti z neodvisnim judgeom.

claim_boundary.en: TSP is the first proving ground; general runtime transfer remains open.
claim_boundary.sl: TSP je prvi proving ground; splošni prenos runtimea ostaja odprt.

claim_boundary.en: ArenaLoop does not claim AGI, consciousness, or continuous subjective identity.
claim_boundary.sl: ArenaLoop ne trdi AGI, zavesti ali neprekinjene subjektivne identitete.

label.en: Final freeze record and spec hash confirmed
label.sl: Končni freeze record in hash specifikacije potrjena

public_note.en: The public copy is byte-identical to the frozen local file.
public_note.sl: Javna kopija je byte-identična zamrznjeni lokalni datoteki.

label.en: Curator and Independent Truth Reviewer appointed
label.sl: Curator in Independent Truth Reviewer imenovana

public_note.en: They must be separate from the Runtime v0.1 Builder.
public_note.sl: Morata biti ločena od Runtime v0.1 Builderja.

label.en: Separate workspaces and storage/access roots created
label.sl: Ustvarjeni ločeni workspacei in storage/access koreni

public_note.en: Different threads in one shared project are not sufficient independence.
public_note.sl: Različne niti v istem deljenem projektu niso zadostna neodvisnost.

label.en: Canonical read-only TSP snapshot selected and hashed
label.sl: Izbran in hashiran kanonični read-only TSP snapshot

public_note.en: Public status does not expose checkpoint identities before release.
public_note.sl: Javni status pred releasom ne razkriva identitet checkpointov.

public_note.en: Includes canonicalization, scoring, and constitutional interfaces.
public_note.sl: Vključuje kanonizacijske, scoring in constitutional vmesnike.

label.en: Proposed evaluator truth built in restricted root
label.sl: Predlagani evaluator truth zgrajen v omejenem korenu

public_note.en: Every scored truth item must be confirmed, corrected, marked ambiguous, or rejected as unsupported.
public_note.sl: Vsaka scored truth postavka mora biti potrjena, popravljena, označena kot dvoumna ali zavrnjena kot nepodprta.

public_note.en: Truth freezes before any Builder output exists.
public_note.sl: Truth se zamrzne pred obstojem Builder outputa.

public_note.en: Minimal CSE-0.1 is required from Phase 0.
public_note.sl: Minimalni CSE-0.1 je zahtevan od Phase 0.

label.en: SHA3 manifests and package disjointness PASS
label.sl: SHA3 manifesti in ločenost paketov PASS

public_note.en: Builder-safe and evaluator-only roots must be disjoint.
public_note.sl: Builder-safe in evaluator-only koreni morajo biti ločeni.

label.en: Access separation and contamination tests PASS
label.sl: Access separation in contamination testi PASS

public_note.en: No evaluator-only material may be reachable from the Builder environment.
public_note.sl: Noben evaluator-only material ne sme biti dosegljiv iz Builder okolja.

public_note.en: Remains HOLD until every prerequisite gate passes.
public_note.sl: Ostane HOLD, dokler ne prestanejo vsi predhodni gate-i.

role_separation.rule: session separation + workspace/project separation + storage/access-root separation

claim_boundary.en: Canonical architecture; not proof of runtime performance.
claim_boundary.sl: Kanonična arhitektura; ni dokaz delovanja runtimea.

claim_boundary.en: Records the hash and freeze decision only.
claim_boundary.sl: Beleži samo hash in odločitev o zamrznitvi.

claim_boundary.en: Read-only public projection; not canonical local state.
claim_boundary.sl: Read-only javna projekcija; ni kanonično lokalno stanje.

claim_boundary.en: Validates public structure, not hidden evidence.
claim_boundary.sl: Validira javno strukturo, ne skritih dokazov.

claim_boundary.en: Lists public releases and their claim boundaries.
claim_boundary.sl: Navaja javne release in njihove meje trditev.

claim_boundary.en: Binds the exported public files and their SHA3-256 hashes; it does not attest hidden implementation state.
claim_boundary.sl: Poveže izvožene javne datoteke in njihove SHA3-256 hashe; ne potrjuje skritega implementacijskega stanja.

claim_boundary.en: Navigation and lineage map; not evidence for architecture performance.
claim_boundary.sl: Navigacijski zemljevid in lineage; ni dokaz delovanja arhitekture.

claim_boundary.en: Defines the only files eligible for public export in this review package.
claim_boundary.sl: Določa edine datoteke, dovoljene za javni izvoz v tem review paketu.

claim_boundary.en: Names forbidden content categories without exposing their private instances.
claim_boundary.sl: Navede prepovedane kategorije vsebine brez razkritja njihovih zasebnih primerov.

claim_boundary.en: Reports fail-closed export scan results without exposing sentinel identifiers or payloads.
claim_boundary.sl: Poroča o fail-closed pregledu izvoza brez razkritja sentinel identifikatorjev ali payloadov.

summary.en: Architecture closed after constitutional and evaluation precision pass; next step is Phase 0.
summary.sl: Arhitektura zaprta po constitutional in evaluation precision passu; naslednji korak je Phase 0.

summary.en: Initial AI8 hub, ArenaLoop page, public status schema, and fail-closed export package prepared for review.
summary.sl: Za pregled pripravljeni začetni AI8 hub, ArenaLoop stran, public status schema in fail-closed export paket.

summary.en: External Bounded-Ridge falsification challenge integrated into the public AI8 hub, ArenaLoop page, and machine-readable map; canonical routes normalized. Frozen architecture and all Phase-0/runtime gate states remain unchanged.
summary.sl: Zunanji falsifikacijski izziv Bounded-Ridge je vključen v javni AI8 hub, ArenaLoop stran in strojno berljivi zemljevid; kanonične poti so normalizirane. Zamrznjena arhitektura ter vsa stanja Phase-0/runtime gate-ov ostajajo nespremenjena.
